text:
alex: Heads-up — planning a quiet deploy tonight to flip the `enable_fast_path_v3` feature flag in prod at 11:00pm PT (03:00 UTC). 
alex: Goal: open a 5% cohort for fast-path latency testing, smoke for errors, then ramp to 25% if stable.
alex: Who can own the toggle and rollback? Also need a quick pre-check and post-smoke signoff.

sam: I can toggle and monitor for the first 30m. I'll be online from 10:45pm PT.
priya: I'll run the smoke tests + perf dashboards (latency p50/p95) and watch error budget.
michael: I'll watch the model infra metrics and KV cache hit rates — fast path touches the shared prefix cache.

alex: Thanks. Pre-checks I want confirmed before flip: 
- migration flag `kv_shared_prefix_enabled` must be ON in prod
- canary health >= 99.5% for last 24h
- staging smoke passed (today at 3pm PT)

priya: staging smoke passed, logs attached. small stderr warnings but not blocking.
priya: Sample staging smoke commands used: 
```
# run smoke suite against staging
curl -X POST https://staging.api.redwood.ai/generate -d '{"prompt":"smoke"}'
python infra/tests/smoke_fastpath.py --count 50
```

sam: prod check: `kv_shared_prefix_enabled` = true across EU/US regions. Verified at 8:10pm PT.

michael: note: if we hit a KV cache thrash we'll see a spike in tail latency and increased GPU utilization on fast-path pool. Canary alert thresholds set.

ops-oncall: I'll be on-call if anything needs rollback assistance. Please ping with timestamps.

alex: Rollback plan: immediate flip back to `false` for `enable_fast_path_v3` + abort any staged ramps. Sam, you should have the CLI toggle handy:
```
redwoodctl flags set enable_fast_path_v3 --value=false --env=prod --region=global
```
alex: If toggle fails, escalate to infra oncall and we'll route traffic away via routing policy (fallback to v2).

deploy-bot: Scheduled maintenance window created: 2026-07-11 23:00 PT -> 23:45 PT. Ticket #INF-4521.

nina: Can we confirm the rollout timing won't overlap with the EU deploy at 11:30pm GMT? (that's 4:30pm PT)
alex: Good catch — EU deploy is earlier today; we are clear for 11:00pm PT. No overlap.

priya: Quick checklist for post-flip smoke (I'll run these):
- 10 quick generation requests across models (text and chat)
- embedding similarity sanity check for sample vectors
- latency p50/p95 per model route
- error rate by tenant (top 10)

sam: I'll do the toggle and confirm via the API: `GET /flags/enable_fast_path_v3` immediately after.

michael: I'll post these metrics to the #observability hook: `obs.fastpath.prod` with p50/p95 and GPU util, + kv hit rate.

priya: If errors > 0.5% or p95 increases > 30% we rollback. Confirmed.

alex: Timing recap:
- 22:45 PT: owners online (sam/priya/michael)
- 23:00 PT: flip to 5%
- 23:00–23:30 PT: smoke + monitor
- 23:30 PT: if stable, ramp to 25% (manual)
- 23:45 PT: end of window, decision to ramp further or keep and open follow-up ticket

sam: I'll post `@here toggle done` after the flip plus the GET output.

deploy-bot: Reminder: canary alerts enabled: fastpath-canary-p95, kv-cache-error-rate.

ops-oncall: If you need me to run the toggle revert, DM me and I'll execute.

nina: small nit — can we add a safe default rule for new tenants to always be excluded from fast path for first 24h? Prevents cold-start surprises.
priya: Good idea — we can add `tenant_exemption_period_days=1` to the rollout config. I'll open a quick patch.

alex: Thanks all. After deploy, please paste the smoke summary (p50/p95, errors, kv hit) in this thread and mark final state.

sam: ack, will update here.

priya: noted — prepping smoke scripts now.

michael: ready on infra side.

sam: 23:00 PT — toggled to 5%. GET shows `{ "enable_fast_path_v3": true, "percent": 5 }`

priya: first 10 requests — p50 45ms, p95 210ms, errors 0.12% — kv hit 98.3%

michael: GPU util stable, no KV thrash spikes. Observability posts sent.

ops-oncall: No alerts. Standby.

sam: 23:27 PT — ramped to 25% after green checks. GET shows `{ "enable_fast_path_v3": true, "percent": 25 }`

priya: post-ramp smoke: p50 48ms, p95 230ms (within threshold), errors 0.18% — ok to keep.

alex: Final state: left at 25% and created follow-up INF-4522 to monitor 24h. Great job team. :thumbsup:

nina: thanks everyone. will check back tomorrow morning for 24h metrics.

sam: closing this thread — will reopen if rollback happens.
